description: This PHP file defines a data transfer object class 'ReviewEmployeeSupervisorSearchFilterParams' used for filtering search parameters related to employee supervisor reviews within the OrangeHRM performance module. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties for employee number and name or ID with associated getter and setter methods.

classes.name: ReviewEmployeeSupervisorSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object used for filtering employee supervisor review searches, allowing specification of employee number and name or ID, and enforcing allowed sorting fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with a default sort field 'employee.empNumber'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: getNameOrId
methods.description: Retrieves the name or ID search criterion.

methods.name: setNameOrId
methods.description: Sets the name or ID search criterion.
